name: Smruthi Organics Limited
about: Smruthi Organics Limited manufactures and markets active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) products to India. The company operates through Bulk Drugs and Drugs Intermediates (API), and Formulation segments. The company provides API for cardiovascular, such as amlodipine besilate, losartan potassium, telmisartan, s - amlodipine besilate, s - amlodipine malelate, and valsartan; for anti diabetic, which comprises metformin HCL, vildagliptin, teneligliptin, and dapagliflozin; and for anti infectives that consists of diloxanide furoate, norfloxacin, and pefloxacin mesylate, as well as ticagrelor for anti platelets. It also offers drug intermediates, such as amlodipine base, s-amlodipine base, and phthaloyl amlodipine. In addition, the company is developing empagliflozin for anti-diabetics; and apixaban and rivaroxaban for anti-platelets. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Solapur, India.
